cases.limit: Preserve existing root spread behavior, then refuse traversal below explicit template scopes. Root-local attrs binding remains a named pre-existing native false positive; no generic template semantic scope parser is introduced.

algorithm.privateHelper: Keep single-root-element and root-template refusals; visit existing validated ElementNode children in source order, skip explicit for/slot-parameter scopes, admit unscoped slot wrappers. Callback reports each exact argumentless attrs binding at trimmed exp.loc span, preserving root message/help and using missing-inheritAttrs-false wording for new nested reports. No intermediate vector or new parse/stage, no script dispatcher/context/registry/helper-family mutation. Preserve existing root directive eligibility even in explicit scopes; stop traversal below those scopes. Only new descendant scope introductions are refused before reporting.
algorithm.limits: Conditional root chains, compound attrs references, multi-root option, opaque values, sibling scripts and explicit template scopes remain named conservative boundaries. No new preset/default/budget policy.
